required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
required.summary: Public Supabase project URL used by the browser client and health checks.

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
required.summary: Browser anon key used by the client runtime and health checks.

required.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
required.summary: Admin-only Supabase access for recovery, admin, and verification helpers.

required.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
required.summary: Canonical application origin for auth redirects and health-route origin checks.

optional.name: APP_URL
optional.summary: Server-side origin fallback when the public app URL is not the correct runtime authority.

optional.name: VERCEL_URL
optional.summary: Platform-provided deployment URL fallback for health-route origin resolution.

optional.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL
optional.summary: Production domain fallback when Vercel injects the canonical project URL.

optional.name: VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
optional.summary: Commit SHA used by the ATLAS health payload.

optional.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA
optional.summary: Client-visible commit SHA fallback for local or preview health payload rendering.

notes: This contract stays intentionally narrow around the ATLAS platform slice and the live health-route dependencies.
Broader repo env inventory still exists in code, but this export only declares the contract-facing subset.
